# CANH BAO: ADDRESS R dung chung cho R cua cung tron. Chi dung khi post xuat cung bang I J K.

# ----- Cach 1: R chi in 1 lan dau chu trinh -----
 ADDRESS R
  {
      FORMAT      Coordinate
      #FORCE       always
      FORCE once
      MAX         99999.999 Truncate
      MIN         -99999.999 Truncate
      LEADER      "R"
      ZERO_FORMAT Zero_real
  }


# ----- Cach 2: khong bao gio ep in R -----

 ADDRESS R
  {
      FORMAT      Coordinate
      FORCE       off
      MAX         99999.999 Truncate
      MIN         -99999.999 Truncate
      LEADER      "R"
      ZERO_FORMAT Zero_real
  }
